summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 appended to ControlType; ControlCode union gains Tuple[ControlType, str]); rich/control.py (format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and Control.title classmethod returning an unstyled Control); rich/console.py (Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, writes the control only when is_terminal, returns bool, never touches Windows APIs); rich/_windows_renderer.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calls term.set_title with the second item). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: console test (forced terminal, skipped on win32), Control.title test, and a Windows-only renderer test asserting set_title("Hello, world!"). Not verified: tests were not run and Black formatting was not checked, per instructions. Choice made: the console test skip uses sys.platform == "win32" rather than the legacy_windows flag.
